name: Checkpoints
description: Packs the project now and then into build/checkpoints, so a bug or a slip can't cost more than a few minutes of map work; any of them can be restored.

mcpTools.name: list_checkpoints
mcpTools.description: The project's checkpoints, newest first. Studio makes them every few minutes while there are saved changes, and before big changes.

mcpTools.name: create_checkpoint
mcpTools.description: Packs the project as it's saved now, as a checkpoint to come back to. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools.

mcpTools.name: restore_checkpoint
mcpTools.description: Puts the whole map back as it was at a checkpoint, unsaved work excluded. The way back after a restart, when undo_last_edit has nothing left. The user has to confirm it in Studio, within about 90 seconds, so tell them to look there first. A checkpoint of the current state is made first. Refused while anything is unsaved. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools.

checkpoints.enabled.description: Pack the project into build/checkpoints every few minutes while it has saved changes. Unsaved edits aren't included.

checkpoints.keep.description: Checkpoints kept per project; older ones are deleted.

checkpoints.maxMegabytes.description: Projects larger than this get no automatic checkpoints (packing them takes long and each copy takes that much disk). Create Checkpoint still works.
